description: This file defines the HintPopover class for managing hint popover UI in the Summernote editor, including initialization, event handling, navigation, and rendering of hint items.

classes.name: HintPopover
classes.description: Class managing the hint popover UI component in Summernote editor, including event handling, navigation, and rendering of hint items.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the HintPopover with context, sets up event handlers and options.

methods.name: shouldInitialize
methods.description: Determines if the popover should initialize based on hints availability.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates and renders the popover element, sets up event listeners.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the popover element from DOM.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Highlights a specific hint item and scrolls it into view.

methods.name: moveDown
methods.description: Moves selection to the next hint item, or next group if at end.

methods.name: moveUp
methods.description: Moves selection to the previous hint item, or previous group if at start.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces the current hint item with its content in the editor.

methods.name: nodeFromItem
methods.description: Creates a DOM node from a hint item.

methods.name: createItemTemplates
methods.description: Generates hint item DOM elements from a list of items.

methods.name: handleKeydown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the popover.

methods.name: searchKeyword
methods.description: Performs search for hints matching a keyword.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a group of hint items based on search results.

methods.name: handleKeyup
methods.description: Handles keyup events to trigger hint search and display.
